name: Manini Mishra/ମାନିନୀ ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Manini Mishra’s Odia poems in Kabita Live bring questioning into both intimate and public life. ତୋ ପାଇଁ କବିତା moves through an insistent series of questions, gathering river water, fire, dust, a smoky moon and lost anklets into an unsettled address. Love, hurt and resistance remain difficult to separate.

In ଅଳ୍ପ ଅଳ୍ପ କଥା, that questioning turns towards the language of budgets, subsidies and public promises. The speaker waits in a customer-service queue, measures taxes against wages and meets economic claims at the price of everyday food. Colloquial phrases and abrupt changes of scale give the poem its satirical edge.
